add.event: 英国通过《1797年银行限制法》
add.evidence: In February 1797, Britain passed the Bank Restriction Act 1797.

add.event: 通缩之后英格兰银行恢复完全兑换
add.evidence: This caused deflation but allowed the Bank to resume full convertibility in 1821.

add.event: 1825年余下时间破产显著增加，1826年近乎翻倍
add.evidence: Bankruptcies increased significantly during the remainder of 1825 and nearly doubled in 1826.
